title: sphaeralcea fendleri subsp. tripartita
intro: Sphaeralcea fendleri subsp. tripartita, commonly known as Fendler's globe mallow or Fendler's Mexican poppy mallow, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mallow family. This plant is known for its vibrant orange flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Sphaeralcea fendleri subsp. tripartita include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating wounds, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as soothing the respiratory tract, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
